controls.name: Unique Agent Identity
controls.description: Every agent has its own unique identity. No shared accounts or reused identities.

controls.name: Short-Lived Certificates
controls.description: Agent authentication uses certificates with limited lifespans (hours to days, not months).

controls.name: Hardware Security Module (HSM)
controls.description: Critical key material stored in tamper-resistant hardware. Private keys never exist outside HSM.

controls.name: Workload Identity Federation
controls.description: Just-in-time credentials instead of long-lived secrets. Cross-cloud support.

controls.name: Identity Audit Trail
controls.description: All agent identity operations logged: creation, rotation, revocation, authentication events.

controls.name: Role-Based Access Control (RBAC)
controls.description: Agents assigned roles mapped to purposes with minimum necessary permissions.

controls.name: Attribute-Based Access Control (ABAC)
controls.description: Multi-attribute decisions: identity, resource properties, environment, action context.

controls.name: On-Behalf-Of (OBO) Flow
controls.description: Delegated permissions: agent operates with intersection of its capabilities and user's access rights.

controls.name: Least Privilege Enforcement
controls.description: API-level, data-level, and tool-level permissions scoped to minimum required.

controls.name: Tool Scope Validation
controls.description: Every tool invocation validated against agent's authorized tool list before execution.

controls.name: Purpose Binding
controls.description: Agents cryptographically bound to specific purposes via signed configuration files.

controls.name: Kill-Switch Capability
controls.description: Immediate termination of agent operations. Separate from agent infrastructure.

controls.name: Resource Usage Caps
controls.description: API call limits, data access volume caps, computation budgets, tool invocation frequency limits.

controls.name: Circuit Breakers
controls.description: Three-state system: Closed (normal), Open (suspended), Half-Open (gradual restoration).

controls.name: Sandboxed Execution
controls.description: Agent operations run in isolated environments with restricted access to sensitive resources.

controls.name: Structured Log Format
controls.description: All logs in structured format (JSON). Each entry: event type, timestamp, agent ID, trace ID, severity.

controls.name: Comprehensive Log Coverage
controls.description: Log inputs, reasoning chains, tool calls, permission decisions, safety events, and outputs.

controls.name: Cryptographic Log Signing
controls.description: Hash chain where modifying one entry invalidates all subsequent entries.

controls.name: Immutable Log Storage
controls.description: Append-only storage (S3 Object Lock, Azure Immutable Blob, GCP Retention Policies).

controls.name: Real-Time Log Replication
controls.description: Logs replicated to multiple destinations concurrently for redundancy.

controls.name: Red Team Exercises
controls.description: Regular adversarial testing: prompt injection, memory poisoning, tool exploitation, goal hijacking.

controls.name: Automated Vulnerability Scanning
controls.description: CI/CD integration: AI security testing platforms, adversarial prompt libraries.

controls.name: Adversarial Prompt Library
controls.description: Maintained library of attack prompts for regular testing against all known vectors.

controls.name: Quarterly Security Validation
controls.description: Repeat red team exercises, update libraries, review controls, test containment quarterly.

controls.name: CI/CD Security Gates
controls.description: Security checks block deployment on failure. Integration with pipeline.
